bullets.text: In a supervised course project, ran a supplied Python notebook to load provided product review records and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.
Executed and inspected supplied scikit-learn notebook procedures to rank documents for provided queries using TF-IDF similarity, then checked retrieved documents against a small judged query set.

Executed and inspected supplied pandas procedures to validate merges through duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used supplied Matplotlib procedures to visualize changes in group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
